clusters.pick_reason: PR #1948 shows the more complete and reviewable fix: it adds explicit capability guards directly in `sendResourceListChanged()`, `sendToolListChanged()`, and `sendPromptListChanged()` in `server/index.ts`, which is a defensive layer that catches all code paths regardless of how capabilities were set. PR #1937's core `mcp.ts` diff is not shown and it is framed as a backport, making #1948 the better base. The changeset file from #1937 can be incorporated into #1948 before merge.
